ideas.title: Bring the neighborhood together
ideas.description: Create a Garden Volunteer and Social Day welcome corner with a shared photo wall and handwritten messages.

ideas.title: Local flavors, happy guests
ideas.description: Plan a seasonal menu for 40 guests. Offer a vegetarian main, clearly label allergens, and confirm dietary needs with RSVPs.

ideas.title: Small footprint, big memories
ideas.description: Use reusable tableware, digital invitations, and locally sourced decor. Set up a refill station and a simple waste sorting area.

plan.aiNotes: This is a community-focused garden day event with a total budget of 50,000 INR. The current status shows 5,000 INR spent on the venue, with significant remaining budget for catering and activities as the event date approaches.
